blocks.raw: # Configuring tier upgrade
blocks.text: Configuring tier upgrade

blocks.raw: When you use tracker values as eligibility criteria for tier upgrades, you must explicitly configure the Transaction Point Allocation action after tracker evaluation. This configuration is required if you want members to skip tiers based on their tracker values.
blocks.text: When you use tracker values as eligibility criteria for tier upgrades, you must explicitly configure the Transaction Point Allocation action after tracker evaluation. This configuration is required if you want members to skip tiers based on their tracker values.

blocks.raw: If you do not configure the Transaction Point Allocation action after tracker evaluation, members will be upgraded one tier at a time, even if their tracker values meet the criteria for higher tiers. Members cannot skip tiers in this case.
blocks.text: If you do not configure the Transaction Point Allocation action after tracker evaluation, members will be upgraded one tier at a time, even if their tracker values meet the criteria for higher tiers. Members cannot skip tiers in this case.

blocks.raw: Tracker values are scoped by the relevant Concept. Make sure you select the correct Concept when setting up tracker-based eligibility criteria.
blocks.text: Tracker values are scoped by the relevant Concept. Make sure you select the correct Concept when setting up tracker-based eligibility criteria.

blocks.raw: From the second tier that you create, you need to configure the eligibility criteria for the tier upgrade and define the upgrade condition for each tier. This needs to be done by going to the Advanced Settings tab.
blocks.text: From the second tier that you create, you need to configure the eligibility criteria for the tier upgrade and define the upgrade condition for each tier. This needs to be done by going to the Advanced Settings tab.

blocks.raw:
> 📘
>
> * The eligibility criteria type that you set for tier upgrade remains the same for all the subsequent tiers that you create.
> * Make sure you create tiers in sequence. You cannot create a new tier between existing tiers and cannot delete an existing tier.
blocks.text: The eligibility criteria type that you set for tier upgrade remains the same for all the subsequent tiers that you create.Make sure you create tiers in sequence. You cannot create a new tier between existing tiers and cannot delete an existing tier.

blocks.raw: 1. Click **Create New Tier** and perform the following:
blocks.text: Click Create New Tier and perform the following:

blocks.raw:
* Name the tier.
* Describe the tier.
* Select an appropriate color for the slab if required.
blocks.text: Name the tier.Describe the tier.Select an appropriate color for the slab if required.

blocks.raw:
2. In **Edit tier**, select **Go to advance settings**.
3. In **Eligibility Criteria**, select the base consideration for tier upgrade.
blocks.text: In Edit tier, select Go to advance settings.In Eligibility Criteria, select the base consideration for tier upgrade.

blocks.raw:
* [Current points](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#current-points)
* [Lifetime points](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#lifetime-points)
* [Lifetime purchases](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#lifetime-purchases)
* [Tracker value](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#trackers) - A minimum of one tracker needs to be available for the Tracker value option to be available.
blocks.text: Current pointsLifetime pointsLifetime purchasesTracker value - A minimum of one tracker needs to be available for the Tracker value option to be available.

blocks.raw:
4. In **Upgrade type**, select type of tier upgrade. This is applied when a customer fulfills the eligibility criteria.
   * [Issue points and then upgrade to the next tier](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#issue-points-and-then-upgrade-to-the-next-tier)
   * [Upgrade to the next tier and then issue points](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#upgrade-to-the-next-tier-and-then-issue-points)
   * [Issue points, upgrade tier, and then issue remaining points](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#issue-points-upgrade-tier-and-then-issue-remaining-points)

5. Select **Add[Secondary Criteria](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/tier-upgrade#secondary-criteria)** , to add another eligibility criteria. For example, if you have the primary eligibility criteria on lifetime purchases, you can also add another tracker value.

blocks.raw: ## Configuring tier upgrades for user groups
blocks.text: Configuring tier upgrades for user groups

blocks.raw: To enable tier upgrades for user groups, you must explicitly configure the SlabUpgrade activity for the User Group entity. This ensures that group-level tier upgrades are processed correctly.
blocks.text: To enable tier upgrades for user groups, you must explicitly configure the SlabUpgrade activity for the User Group entity. This ensures that group-level tier upgrades are processed correctly.

blocks.raw: ## Validate downgrade conditions for a return transaction
blocks.text: Validate downgrade conditions for a return transaction

blocks.raw: Enabling this option allows you to downgrade a customer if the customer returns the transaction that upgraded the customer to a higher tier.
blocks.text: Enabling this option allows you to downgrade a customer if the customer returns the transaction that upgraded the customer to a higher tier.
